reason: The equivalence assumes right - x = (left - x) + 79 also holds for the unsigned 16-bit comparisons the original makes, but the invariant holds only mod 65536 and the viewport can wrap. reset_screen_scroll sets left &FFB0 / right &FFFF (Y = 0, DEY), and observer mode's LEFT (game.6502 observer_mode_loop) calls scroll_screen_left with no bound at the world's start, decrementing the player's movers_x with it, and update_screen_observer renders. Example: left &FFD0, right &001F, player x &FFF0. Original: left - x = &FFE0 with a borrow, so jmin = 0. Then right - x = &002F with a borrow, so C = 0 and it takes the RTS: the mover is not drawn (in SKY_MODE, C set). Candidate: high byte &FF, INC A gives 0, &E0 + 79 carries, so jmax = &2F and it goes on to jmax_done and draws the mover. That changes the screen, the arena and the records. The same wrap gives another divergence: x > right with left at &FFxx makes the original RTS while the candidate goes on to draw with jmin = jmax = &FF. So the relied-on invariant does not give equivalence on a reachable path (observer mode at the world's start, which tools/observer.mjs drives). Counts: hot path 48 -> 41 cycles with dm_jmin/dm_jmax absolute (7 saved, as claimed); the window grows 7 bytes (32 -> 39) and leaves not_right_of_view dead.
